statement: At the observed Human opening of script S-4a5f, build-800c grants 4 actions while build-c602 grants 3 actions; both builds triggered a Human-owned Teleport when the Human piece entered C3.
trigger: At the first Human turn of the fixed S-4a5f script.
condition: The build is build-800c or build-c602 under otherwise matching scripted opening actions.
effect: build-800c: 4 opening actions; build-c602: 3 opening actions; in both cases, entry on C3 fired Teleport and moved h1 to J3.
evidence: C-0b60d5 steps 0-4 (build-800c); C-3a7366 steps 0-4 (build-c602); both are script S-4a5f.
